bullets.text: In Avadi, two dairy cows belonging to Kuppan and Ponni died after electric wires snapped and fell, and the office should monitor compensation.
Near Avadi bus stand, a parked two-wheeler caught fire due to a Deepavali firecracker spark, and the district team should review safety measures.
Technology distributors like Redington and Ingram Micro are benefiting from India's AI boom by expanding beyond iPhones to GPUs, and the portfolio team should track this growth.

stories.title: ஆவடி அருகே சோகம்..! மின்சார ஒயர்கள் அறுந்து விழுந்ததில் 2 கறவை மாடுகள் உயிரிழப்பு..!
takeaways: Two dairy cows died from snapped electricity wires near Avadi in Thiruvallur district.
Local authorities must inspect electrical lines urgently to prevent further animal or human casualties.

stories.title: பட்டாசு தீப்பொறி பட்டு இருசக்கர வாகனம் தீப்பற்றி எரிந்தது!
takeaways: A parked two-wheeler caught fire from cracker sparks near Avadi bus station during Diwali.
No injuries were reported, but local safety advisories for cracker disposal may increase.

stories.title: From iPhones to GPUs: Redington, Ingram Micro ride the AI boom
takeaways: Redington Ltd and Ingram Micro are emerging as major beneficiaries of India's artificial intelligence boom.
Both companies are expanding their traditional hardware supply models to include advanced AI infrastructure.
